implemented: EOD close requires a complete, same-session, source-hashed mark for every nonzero position.
Known working orders are canceled with exact fills retained and unfilled reservation released; unknown/submitted unresolved orders fail closed.
NAV snapshot requires account equity, cash ledger, total return, inventory, mark, and cash-flow reconciliation.
Canonical immutable archive includes account journal head, cash/NAV, orders, positions, marks, and provenance hashes.
Restart verification compares reopened cash, NAV, quantities, average costs, marks, order closure, and snapshot content hash.
Atomic archive file creation is deterministic and retry-safe.
blockers: No scheduled daily launcher invokes the close workflow yet.
Authoritative close-price feed and data entitlement are not bound to the service.
No prospective EOD-to-next-open market cycle has been recorded.
